mission: Owner 'perfectionist' 2026-10-31: get the 13 Claude reviews of #242 to mappings. They validate (identity-proof-check, zero refusals) but their stored proposal groups stayed ambiguous, and approve-f1-batch reads stored exact groups only. New owner-gated ops-write runbook proposal-refresh refreshes, through discovery's own persistence, exactly the stored ambiguous groups a review now resolves. Also trims identity-proof-check's summary (311 rows overflowed the annotation budget).

impacts.reason: Write runbook (not collector-affecting: proposals only). Plan = pending ambiguous yuyutei groups whose fresh analysis (refresh_discovery_proposals' filters) is exact by retained_positive_unique_physical_artwork_review; SHA over candidate, new digest, selected print. Apply re-plans in the write transaction, refuses on any difference, calls refresh_discovery_proposals for exactly those ids and requires every result exact. One transaction. Expected 13 groups.
Summary rows: actor added; rows already exact by another rule counted, not listed.

Only the reviewed group is planned and refreshed to exact; another ambiguous group is untouched; a stale plan is refused; dry run by default, apply needs the SHA. 76 passed with the proof tests on local Postgres 16.

resources: Yuyu-Tei source_mapping_proposal_groups for listings a review resolves (13 expected)

recovery.procedure: Native revert PR; a refreshed group is an ordinary pending proposal and can be rejected on the admin review page.
recovery.trigger: A group refreshed that no review resolves, or approve-f1-batch refuses a refreshed group.

verification.observation_window: proposal-refresh dry run (13 candidates), apply, then approve-f1-batch dry run.
